secret_marker_scan.patterns: private-key blocks, Supabase personal tokens, GitHub token literal markers only; not a comprehensive secret audit

ownership_policy: Preserve all existing user work. Grouping identifies current task scope, not authorship. Integrator must approve generated baselines, unclassified changes, raw logs and binary evidence. No blanket staging.
freeze_policy: These are current file hashes, not a freeze: agents and hosted evidence remain active. Recompute and compare approved paths after final acceptance/build; reject unexpected path/hash changes.

planned_staging_policy.procedure: Construct a NUL-delimited pathspec from reviewed exact entries; verify hashes and exclusion rules immediately before git add --pathspec-from-file=<file> --pathspec-file-nul. Then inspect cached name-status, diff --check and secret scan. Do not execute until final release authorization and gates pass.
never: Stage any public_git_exclusions path or any descendant of tools/squad/private.

limitations: Existing tracked node_modules remain part of historical checkout; their local dirty entries are excluded, not silently deleted.
The final release must use an approved commit SHA/build and rerun served asset/deep-link checks after Vercel deploy.

post_snapshot_validation.conclusion: Expected concurrent agent work; snapshot must be regenerated at actual release freeze. These two review artifacts themselves are intentionally not self-hashed.
